newsitem.title: UK: BADMINTON-ENGLAND STAR ARCHER WARNED FOR SWEARING.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-ENGLAND STAR ARCHER WARNED FOR SWEARING.

text.p: England's Simon Archer was given an unofficial warning on Wednesday after swearing at a steward at the Sudirman Cup world mixed team championships.
The incident occurred on Tuesday night after England had lost 5-0 to China, the defending champions.
Colin Atkinson, the deputy championship director, reported Archer to English manager Steve Baddeley.

"We aren't asking England to take any official disciplinary action, things can happen in the heat of the moment," said Atkinson. "But it is also unacceptable for volunteers, or anyone, to be on the receiving end of such treatment."
